proposals.before: Under Prince Rui's regency Tan Tai enjoyed the confidence of Tulai, chief of the bayara guard, and Sonin of the Council of Deliberation alike.
proposals.after: Under Prince Rui's regency Tan Tai, together with Tulai, chief of the bayara guard, and Sonin the investigatory secretary, all enjoyed the prince's trust.
proposals.reason: Chinese 並見信任 means Tan Tai, Tulai, and Sonin were all trusted by the regent; the idiomatic English reverses who trusts whom.

proposals.before: He was soon told to garrison Xi'an; marching through Henan he put down bandits in Dingxi and Pingliang, including Liu Hongqi.
proposals.after: He was soon told to garrison Xi'an; marching through Henan he put down the Xiping bandits, including Liu Hongqi.
proposals.reason: Chinese 西平土寇 refers to bandits of Xiping, not Dingxi and Pingliang; the place name was mistranslated.

proposals.before: He was soon ordered to lead troops to garrison Xi'an; passing through Henan he suppressed the bandits of Dingxi and Pingliang such as Liu Hongqi.
proposals.after: He was soon ordered to lead troops to garrison Xi'an; passing through Henan he suppressed the bandits of Xiping such as Liu Hongqi.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise misreads 西平 as Dingxi and Pingliang.

proposals.before: When Prince Su returned, Beile Tunqi and others impeached him; He Luohui testified again, and the prince lost his title and died under house arrest.
proposals.after: When Prince Su returned, Beizi Tunqi and others impeached him; He Luohui testified again, and the prince lost his title and died under house arrest.
proposals.reason: Chinese 貝子屯齊 is Beizi (prince of the fourth degree), not Beile.

proposals.before: After Prince Rui's death, when the Shizu took power, He Luohui told Beile Xi Han: "The Yellow Banner ministers hate me; I denounced Prince Su—will they spare me now?"
proposals.after: After Prince Rui's death, when the Shizu took power, He Luohui told Beizi Xi Han: "The Yellow Banner ministers hate me; I denounced Prince Su—will they spare me now?"
proposals.reason: Chinese 貝子錫翰 is Beizi, not Beile.

proposals.before: In the seventh year, when Prince Rui fell ill and resented the emperor's absence, Leng Sengji and Xi Han asked the throne to visit; though Prince Rui punished the request, an amnesty restored him and Leng Sengji was made a first-class baron.
proposals.after: In the seventh year, when Prince Rui fell ill and resented the emperor's absence, Leng Sengji and Beizi Xi Han asked the throne to visit; Leng Sengji was reduced in hereditary rank for the unauthorized request, then an amnesty restored him and advanced him to first-class baron.
proposals.reason: Chinese 坐以擅請降世職 refers to Leng Sengji's demotion for unauthorized solicitation, not punishment of Prince Rui.

proposals.before: Xitu Ku and Boerhui too had long service with merit.
proposals.after: Xitu Ku and Boerhui too had long followed campaigns with merit.
proposals.reason: Chinese 久從征戰有勞 specifies long campaign service; idiomatic 'long service' omits 征戰.

proposals.before: Boerhui and others exposed Xitu Ku: each denouncing the other, they all went to execution together.
proposals.after: Xitu Ku's execution was exposed by Boerhui and others: each denouncing the other, they all went to execution together.
proposals.reason: Chinese opens with 錫圖庫之誅 (Xitu Ku's execution); idiomatic drops that framing and reduces it to 'exposed Xitu Ku'.

decisions.reason: s0027 has 譚泰與…圖賴、…索尼並見信任: the three men alike received Prince Rui's trust. The before line reverses the trust relation (Tan Tai enjoying theirs) and mis-titles 啟心郎 as Council of Deliberation; the proposed wording restores both.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 譚泰與巴牙喇纛章京圖賴、啟心郎索尼並見信任

decisions.reason: s0082 has 討定西平土寇: 討定 is the verb 'suppress/pacify' and 西平 is the place Xiping (on the Henan route to Xi'an), not Dingxi and Pingliang. The proposed idiomatic replacement corrects that toponym error.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 討定西平土寇劉洪起等

decisions.reason: Same reading as the idiomatic line: 西平 is one place name after 討定, not Dingxi plus Pingliang. The proposed literal correctly renders 西平土寇 as the bandits of Xiping.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 討定西平土寇劉洪起等

decisions.reason: s0092 has 貝子屯齊: 貝子 is Beizi, distinct from 貝勒 (Beile). The proposed change corrects only that title.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 貝子屯齊等訐王諸悖妄狀

decisions.reason: s0095 has 貝子錫翰: again 貝子, not 貝勒. Replacing Beile with Beizi matches the Chinese title.

After 冷僧機及貝子錫翰等奏請上臨視, 睿親王坐以擅請降世職 names Prince Rui as the punisher who reduced hereditary rank for unauthorized solicitation; 恩詔復故，進一等伯 then restores and advances Leng Sengji. The before line muddles who was demoted; the proposed wording correctly assigns the demotion–amnesty–advancement to Leng Sengji and restores Beizi for Xi Han.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 冷僧機及貝子錫翰等奏請上臨視，睿親王坐以擅請降世職，恩詔復故，進一等伯

decisions.reason: s0193 has 久從征戰有勞: 征戰 specifies campaign/warfare service. Omitting it as mere 'long service' drops that military content; the proposed 'long followed campaigns with merit' restores it without over-rewriting.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 錫圖庫、博爾輝亦久從征戰有勞

decisions.reason: s0195 opens with 錫圖庫之誅，博爾輝等發之: the topic is Xitu Ku's execution, which Boerhui and others exposed. The before line flattens that to 'exposed Xitu Ku'; the proposed wording restores the 之誅 framing.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 錫圖庫之誅，博爾輝等發之
